reason: MIXED: C1 passes decisively (240/240 oracle-free DYNAMIC decode correct, 0 ambiguous tie-breaks, method distribution identical to parent oracle-guided). This is the critical scientific finding — the deployable decoder works without SHA256 oracle on Cloudflare CDN DYNAMIC responses. However, frozen decision_rule SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires ALL C1-C7 pass; C2 (CDN HIT >=90% correct) is untestable because Cloudflare quick tunnel free-tier does not cache responses despite Cache-Control: public, max-age=300 (0% HIT rate, all 48 DYNAMIC). This is an infrastructure ceiling, not a negative scientific result. The frozen spec required N=5 per HIT cell (240 total) but producer implemented N=1 per cell (48 total), further reducing evaluation power even if HITs were observed. Per frozen decision_rule clause 'IF C1 passes but C2 fails: MIXED — oracle-free works for DYNAMIC but HIT staleness is unresolvable', the correct verdict is MIXED. The audit REVISE status (producer_claim_supported=false) is accepted: the frozen gate cannot be claimed SURVIVES when C2 is unmet. The parent's oracle circularity gap (audit V1, EXP-RUNTIME-35542474231) is resolved by this experiment — oracle-free decode is validated for DYNAMIC. The HIT gap (parent audit V3) remains open and requires different infrastructure.
